Class ImageControllerImplTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • ImageControllerImplTest
  • public class ImageControllerImplTest
extends java.lang.Object
    This class tests the Controller, if it's reading the input correctly and calling the correct method in the model by using a mock model and log statements.
